items.claim: CFO 公布全年營收財測上調 5 億美元至 175–178 億
items.quote: range of $17.5 billion to $17.8 billion
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明調整後 EBITDA 財測上調 3 億並維持全年利潤率持平
items.quote: expectation to bring the revenue growth to the bottom
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 總租賃 CapEx 財測上調 4.5 億，因需求更強
items.quote: we've increased our gross CapEx guidance by $450 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 自由現金流財測維持 21.5–24.5 億，CapEx 增加由營運現金流增加抵銷
items.quote: we are reaffirming another year of strong free cash flow
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 表示不給 2027 財測，但認為順風延續到明年
items.quote: We're not going to go as far as give '27 guidance
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明 CapEx 季節節奏：新財測下 Q3 約引進 30–35%
items.quote: somewhere around 30% to 35% in Q3 -- balance in Q4,
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 對下半年租賃營收成長不給落點，提醒看區間，主要變數為附屬與轉租，下次 10 月更新
items.quote: we would point people towards the range,
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說四月已有信心但通常不在四月上調，實際表現超出預期、專案管線更快更深
items.quote: The pipeline of projects moved faster and got deeper.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 拆解利潤率：報表口徑 +70bp，扣除出售鷹架業務利得後 -40bp
items.quote: Excluding both the gain on the sale of our scaffolding
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 再扣除附屬與轉租超額成長後，核心利潤率年增 40bp
items.quote: margins were up 40 basis points year-on-year, even
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說附屬收入的燃料與運送成本轉嫁帶來營收但增量利潤有限
items.quote: brought limited incremental margin dollars.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 量化第二季自用燃料成本對利潤率的額外逆風
items.quote: 20 or 30 basis points of additional headwind year-on-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明全年利潤率目標為持平（排除去年 H&E 影響）
items.quote: flat margins, excluding the impact of H&E last year.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 以去年對照量化運送成本：去年交貨成本增 20% 對租賃營收 6–7%，隱含約 1.15 億超額成本；今年 Q2 租賃營收 +12.7%、交貨 +11.7%
items.quote: rental revenue up 12.7%, delivery up 11.7%.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說勞力、運送、維修三大核心成本今年皆領先預期曲線
items.quote: we're actually ahead of the curve on all 3.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說第二季重組節省約 1,200 萬，已達年化速率；累計費用 5,100 萬，全年預期 5,500–6,500 萬
items.quote: benefit was on the order of about $12 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱附屬收入難以預測，Q3 燃料價格預期與 Q2 持平
items.quote: Our expectation is that fuel prices probably
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說成本改善來自流程改變與執行，而非 CapEx 緩解重新調配成本
items.quote: is really more process change and execution
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 開場稱成長加速、客戶對大型專案保持樂觀
items.quote: Customers remain optimistic
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說在地市場自一月以來已穩定，本地客戶約低個位數成長
items.quote: we are seeing stabilization with some very modest growth.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 確認半導體與電力（含資料中心）第二季雙雙加速
items.quote: Both of those have accelerated here in the second quarter.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說電力垂直市場占營收逾一成
items.quote: in excess of 10% of our business
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說石化與工業製造目前並未轉強，屬尚未啟動的上行空間；下游業者推遲歲修
items.quote: Industrial manufacturing is not really hot right now.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說需求超預期主因是大型專案管線，涵蓋面廣
items.quote: projects across the board are just stronger and deeper
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 專長業務租賃營收年增 25%，含 11 個新開據點
items.quote: exceptional rental revenue growth of 25% year-over-year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說專長業務七大線皆雙位數成長，行動模組/儲存與 ROS 成長最快但規模最小
items.quote: I'll tell you, they're all in the double digits.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說電力產品十年來有機成長雙位數、據點已建置完成
items.quote: organically has been growing double digits for us
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說 AI 定價工具部分仍在試行，目前價格成功主因是產業紀律
items.quote: some things that we're working that are really in pilot
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱產業供需紀律是目前租金成功的最大因素
items.quote: that discipline that is critical.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 認為 URI 時間利用率高於產業，但產業整體也在提升
items.quote: the industry overall is driving higher time utilization
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說產業整併會持續，連激進新開據點模式的業者也轉向併購
items.quote: The bigs will continue to get bigger.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 承認部分設備類別供給偏緊，額外 10 億美元設備買不到
items.quote: we wouldn't be able to get it.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說若本地市場同時強勁，疊加大型專案需求將有供給挑戰
items.quote: it would be challenging today.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 指出運送重新調配成本仍在處理中，下半年須持續維持
items.quote: We've got to keep it up, right?
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說上半年回饋股東 9.98 億，含回購 7.5 億與股利 2.48 億
items.quote: $750 million through repurchases and $248 million
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 重申今年回購 15 億，加股利約回饋 20 億
items.quote: intend to repurchase $1.5 billion of shares in 2026
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: S&P 將展望調為正向，12 個月內有機會升投資等級
items.quote: raising our credit outlook to positive from stable
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說移向投資等級不影響資本配置與併購策略，內部政策原先使其留在高收益級
items.quote: internal financial policy that kept us in the high-yield
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說併購管線穩健，成長 90% 以上為有機
items.quote: the pipeline continues to be robust.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說併購以現金報酬率框架呈現，因收購會計可能短期稀釋 ROIC
items.quote: And that's why we frame the deals really as
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 稱團隊靠艦隊生產力「贏得」額外 CapEx，且租金需抵銷通膨
items.quote: they earned this extra CapEx by
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示預期租金與各項艦隊生產力組成皆為正向
items.quote: But rate is a good guy, and we expect it to
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 表示明年仍會成長，但幅度與 CapEx 待規劃；預期多賣一些二手設備
items.quote: expect next year to certainly be another year of growth
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說公司不會迴避客戶要求的小型附屬服務，並會向市場說明對利潤率的影響
items.quote: So we're not going to shy away from them.
items.speaker: CFO

qa_flags.question: Rob Wertheimer / Ken Newman：租金（rate）是否已到位、後半年是否改善
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層一貫不給租金數字，只說「rate is a good guy」並預期持續，未回答是否到位

qa_flags.question: David Raso：Q2 剔除利得後利潤率 -40bp 到下半年隱含 +10–20bp 的擺動因素
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未列出擺動因素，改談上半年底層 +10bp 與「季度間正常變動」，並重述全年持平目標

qa_flags.question: Steve Fisher：CapEx 增加能否減輕重新調配成本、何時不必再提
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先否認目前有特別強調，並否定 CapEx 為正向吸收原因；CFO 稱難以量化

qa_flags.question: Jamie Cook：CapEx 增加中 gen rent 與 specialty 的占比
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 拒絕拆分，僅稱可假設專長業務占不少

qa_flags.question: Tami Zakaria：下半年租賃營收成長是否放緩
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 不給具體預期，要求看區間，並稱要到 10 月才有更新
